name: @pipeworx/mcp-bug-bounty-programs

tools.name: bounty_programs_search
tools.description: Search public bug-bounty program directories on Bugcrowd, YesWeHack and HackerOne — program name, cash bounty range, and status (open/paused/disabled), each sourced from that platform's own public, unauthenticated directory. has_wildcard checks real scope asset identifiers on YesWeHack and HackerOne (Bugcrowd's scope is behind a researcher login and is reported as such, not silently empty).

platform.description: Restrict to one platform. Omit to search all three.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the program name.

min_bounty.description: Only programs whose published max bounty (USD) is at least this.

launched_since.description: ISO date. Only programs with a known launch date on/after this (currently HackerOne only — see bounty_new_programs note).

has_wildcard.description: Only programs whose scope includes a wildcard asset ("*.example.com"). Checked via a per-program detail call on yeswehack/hackerone; unavailable for bugcrowd (login-walled).

tools.name: bounty_program
tools.description: One bug-bounty program by platform + handle: bounty range, status, and scope assets where the platform publishes them without a login. YesWeHack returns a full severity x asset-value reward table; HackerOne returns real scope but no numeric reward table (not exposed publicly); Bugcrowd returns neither (login-walled) and says so.

handle.description: The program's slug/handle on that platform, e.g. "security" on HackerOne or "cryptobox-bug-bounty" on YesWeHack.

tools.name: bounty_new_programs
tools.description: Bug-bounty programs launched in the last N days, by real launch date. Currently HackerOne only — the only one of the three platforms that publishes a `launched_at` field without a login; Bugcrowd and YesWeHack expose no launch-date field at all (confirmed by enumerating their public endpoints), and are named, not silently merged in.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bug-bounty-programs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bug-bounty-programs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
